name: jev-agent-kit
description: Measured Jev log pruning and loop observation for Claude Code; native Mod with classic-hook fallback and original-log read-back

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe records only; assist shortens long Bash output. Applies to every opted-in project unless its .claude/jev-agent-kit.json says otherwise.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: rules is local and sends nothing. jev also sends redacted log blocks to TypeSafe (costs money, needs an API key).

minimum_chars.title: Minimum output length
minimum_chars.description: Bash output shorter than this many characters is never touched.

keep_threshold.title: Jev keep threshold
keep_threshold.description: Probability (0 to 1) a non-error block needs for Jev to keep it. Only used with the jev backend.

retention_days.title: Keep stored logs (days)
retention_days.description: Stored original logs and decision records older than this are deleted.

enable_all_projects.title: Enable in every project
enable_all_projects.description: Off by default: a project must opt in with .claude/jev-agent-kit.json. Turn on to use the plugin everywhere without per-project files.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional. Only needed for the jev backend. Stored in your system's secure storage, never in a project file.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model requested from TypeSafe. Default is pinned so decisions stay calibrated. Set jev-latest to follow the newest model (re-check results after it changes). Only used with the jev backend.
